cards: It all starts with a threat known as the Uca Major. A malevolent eldritch nightmare that ravages the depths of the cove. Head down there and finds its lair, and deliver us from this evil crustacean horror's influence.
Objective Rooms always spawn 1 Uca Major first and then the rest of the Monsters from the Monster Deck as normal.

The murky waters of the cove didn't used to be as such. The mere presence of its unholy denizens threatens our very own existence. If you don't put an end to them, it's going to turn into a fetid pool of virulent sickness. Head down there and clean the fetid lair. Halt the contamination for good.
When a Hero kills a Cove Monster they suffer 2[blight] 3t.

The emerging threat from the cove can mean only one thing, that the eldritch signs etched to the grotto's walls have been corrupted. Take these potions and imbue them once more with the arcane energy they require. Keep them active, to protect us from the evil that resides down there.

Set aside Room Cards [cove]1 and [cove]9. When entering an Objective Room, draw one of those cards at random and at the end of the encounter set it aside again. At the start of the Quest you can turn any Provision to [potion]. Once per battle, when a Hero is in an Area [red-area] of an Objective Room they can discard a Potion to purify the Eldritch Sign.

You have been there more than once. Yet we know little of the area we call the cove. Now that the tide is low, you should venture there once more and map out the underground caverns carefully. We know that something sinister lives there, yet we can't fathom where it resides.
Always initiate battle in Curio Rooms.

Rancid, fetid, and obscene. That's how the cove waters smell nowadays. Yet we know that the unclean lairs hidden in its depths are the cause of it all. Swim down there and put an end to this, quickly and efficiently.
When a Hero kills a Cove Monster they suffer 3[blight] 3t.
The madness has not yet ended, for a Uca Major plagues the tumultuous waters of the cove. No matter how many you kill, they always come back for more. Find out why, and end them once and for all...
Objective Rooms always spawn 1 Uca Major and 1 Squiffy Ghast first and then 1 more Monster from the Monster Deck.

These horrific fish-nightmares reside deep in the cove's rancid lairs. Yet we still haven't located them, and that's what you should do. Head down there and brave the cove's dangers. Find the place they live in and put them to the sword!

Objective Rooms are Rooms [cove]2, [cove]5, [cove]6 & [cove]8. Set these Rooms aside at the Dungeon start, and pick one of them at random each time you enter an Objective Room. Spawn only Cove Monsters in Objective Rooms.

You have braved many dangers, but not the eldritch nightmares of the cove. We have found the places of power where they gather and perform their sacrilegious ceremonies. Deep into the underground grotto, you should find them there. Do your job and make sure they never return...
Always initiate battle in Curio Rooms. After clearing a Curio Room, suffer only the negative effects of a Curio Card.

It is painful to ask, but you should head down the cove once more. But now the situation is much more dire. The creatures that reside there have grown restless. Thus you should go down there and ransack their lairs. But try to remain unfazed by the creeping madness that resides behind its wet walls...
Always initiate battle in Curio Rooms. After clearing a Curio Room suffer only the negative effects of a Curio Card.

The waters are still poisonous, and even though you've tried as much, you can only do one final thing to end the spreading of its disease. Head down to the rancid lair, ransack it, and make sure that no unclean horror emerges from it... ever...again.
When a Hero kills a Cove Monster they suffer 3[blight] 4t.

The most dangerous of these fish-monsters have yet to be put to the sword! Thus, you have one final task. Head down, deep in their lairs, and find these abominable deep ones. Make sure they never swim up to the surface for vengeance...

Objective Rooms are Rooms [cove]2, [cove]5, [cove]6 & [cove]8. Set these Rooms aside at the Dungeon start, and pick one of them at random each time you enter an Objective Room. Spawn 1 Squiffy Ghast and only Cove Monsters in Objective Rooms.

Long ago, a ship filled with idols was lost ashore. Its wreckage was never found, yet the lingering influence of the idols remains up to this day. The monsters are aware of their corrupting influence. Thus, you must go down to the cove's depths and find them... and destroy them...
Room [cove]7 is the Objective Room. When searching in [green-area] Areas, rolling 4-8 will give you an idol in place of the provision of your choice. Only one idol can be found per shipwreck.

All that glitters is not gold, some treasures bear a curse untold. These tainted trinkets are waiting for you to be purified, lest we risk getting corrupted by their demonic influence. You know how...

Objective Rooms are: [cove]1, [cove]5, [cove]9. Each Hero gets 1 level 3 Trinket at random, those Trinkets are considered tainted. If a Hero can't get a Trinket, they choose one of theirs to become tainted. When in an Objective Room, a Hero can spend one action in Area [red-area] (this can be done only once per Room) to cleanse the Trinket and score one objective. Upon returning to Hamlet, each Hero with a tainted Trinket can suffer 2 negative Quirks and cleanse it, or remove it and shuffle it back into its respective deck.
